description: Versioned template + profile registry for the ISH D template engine. Names here are the ONLY names a manifest may reference. Values are the LOCKED creative params — the app encodes these, it does not redesign them. To change a locked param, add a NEW versioned name; never edit a name in place.

club_dispatch_acamonly_v1.pacing: Grade, crop, graphics and audio only

club_dispatch_pb3_v1.applies_to: A-cam (approved 2026-08-25). B-cuts use club_dispatch_pb3_b_v1 when present (renderer resolves per angle).
club_dispatch_pb3_v1.note: APPROVED NEUTRAL grade (2026-08-25, user rejected BRIGHT+WARM as too orange on night footage). Source: club-dispatch-vol1-tester-resume-2026-08-25.md. SUPERSEDED warm chain kept for trace: eq=brightness=0.06:saturation=1.12,colorbalance=rs=0.09:bs=-0.06:rm=0.03 (runbook 08-18 table, now corrected).

club_dispatch_pb3_b_v1.applies_to: B-cam (GoPro) inserts ONLY. Shadow-lift curves for dark night footage; added 2026-08-27 after the half-runtime proof showed B inserts unreadably dark.
club_dispatch_pb3_b_v1.note: GRADE_B from 2026-08-26-tester-postmortem.md + video-weave-runbook.md. Renders B cuts with this chain when the manifest grade is club_dispatch_pb3_v1 (renderer rule: <name>_b_v1 for B angle). yuv444p risk: curves chain up-converts chroma — renderers MUST append format=yuv420p after grade (both do).

cd_a_pushin_v1.note: A push-in (1.15x, hides B-rig). The VAAPI-spine form was verified on the v6 canonical redo; exact filter placement is the renderer's job.
cd_a_pushin_v1.source: video-weave-runbook.md canonical settings + 2026-08-26 canonical redo lessons

cd_bug_v9.locked_params: bug overlay v9 (CD bug). Exact overlay asset + placement owned by the renderer/hyperframes; this name locks WHICH bug, not the filter graph.
cd_bug_v9.content_bbox_source: union alpha bbox over all 240 frames, threshold 16/255 (the plateau at >=16; the legacy hard-coded crop=152:152:71:505 is exactly this box). Measured 2026-09-13 by tools/graphics/union_bbox.py.
cd_bug_v9.geometry_added: 2026-09-13 — geometry/asset/frames keys added so the profile owns its own crop and placement. locked_params and source unchanged; the rendered filter chain and position are byte-identical to the previous renderer constants (crop=152:152:71:505, overlay=72:904).

orbit_relay_v1.locked_params: Orbit Relay v1 (CD bug). Approved artwork uploaded 2026-09-13 (orbit_relay_v1_upload_ready.zip). 240-frame RGBA loop, 600x600 canvas; placement is bottom-right and is computed from the MEASURED union alpha content bbox, never from the transparent canvas.
orbit_relay_v1.source: orbit_relay_v1_upload_ready.zip -> /mnt/media/graphics/orbit_relay/v1 (checksum manifest 245 OK / 0 FAILED, 240 contiguous frames, verified 2026-09-13)
orbit_relay_v1.content_bbox_source: union alpha bbox over all 240 frames, threshold 8/255 (identical 1..64: the artwork's alpha edge is hard, so the threshold is not critical). Padding in the 600x600 canvas: left 42, right 74, top 79, bottom 123 — positioning from the canvas would have been wrong by exactly that padding. Measured 2026-09-13 by tools/graphics/union_bbox.py.
orbit_relay_v1.reference_asset: orbit_relay_v1.mov (qtrle/argb, 600x600, 30 fps, 8.000 s) — reference/fallback only; the verified PNG sequence is the production source of truth.

locked_params.chain: loudnorm=I=-13.5:LRA=6.4:TP=-1.5 (two-pass, from clean continuous A bed) -> alimiter=limit=0.60:level=false -> volume=+0.55dB (makeup only if loudness dips)
locked_params.bitrate_rule: AAC 320k is the delivery bitrate. 192k CANNOT pass the -1.5 dBTP gate on DJ audio (encoder ringing).
locked_params.limiter_rule: alimiter=limit=0.60:level=false ONLY. Never limit=0.95, never default level (level defaults to a no-op auto-level).

gate.measure_on: delivered file, full program; cross-check AAC TP via decoded WAV (loudnorm JSON over-reads on AAC input)
